scope: Pins downloadable official release assets observed during the build. Entries marked `pinned` or `pinned-url` contain SHA-256 hashes; `skip-upstream` entries are deliberately not installed from a pinned upstream asset. The current lock does not pin or claim a KytyPS5 source build. The Debian base-image digest is pinned; Debian APT versions are time-pinned only when APT_SNAPSHOT_TIMESTAMP is set. This does not guarantee bit-for-bit reproducibility across architectures/build environments.

kytyps5.reason: Source-build inputs are not represented by this downloadable-asset lock. Keep skipped until the source commit, build inputs, toolchain and resulting artifact hash are captured by a dedicated reproducible build path.

shadps4.reason: No compatible official Linux binary or source-build result is pinned with verified inputs and SHA-256 in this lock. Keep upstream installation skipped until a reproducible, reviewable official artifact/build path is captured.

ppsspp.reason: No official Linux upstream asset is pinned with a verified SHA-256 in this lock. A trusted distro package or user-supplied binary may still be detected separately; neither should be inferred from this skip entry.

xbox-one.reason: Intentional safety block: this catalog profile has no supported full-system Xbox One runner. Do not install or launch a generic/unrelated executable to make the profile appear available.
